name: save_bmp
source: var w=new Window(),p=new Layer(w,null),s=new Layer(w,p);s.setImageSize(7,5);for(var y=0;y<5;y++)for(var x=0;x<7;x++){s.setMainPixel(x,y,((x*31+y*17)<<16)|((x*19+y*23)<<8)|(x*11+y*29));s.setMaskPixel(x,y,(x*23+y*31)%256);}var modes=['bmp8','bmp24','bmp32'];for(var i=0;i<3;i++)s.saveLayerImage(System.exePath+modes[i]+'.bmp',modes[i]);return 1;
